During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a survey team was charting an '''uninhabited planet''' in the [[Lorardia system/Legends|Lorardia system]] when they received unusual readings. The readings were determined to be caused by large deposits of [[maranium]] underneath the surface.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Strange Survey}}</ref>
